name: auvezy-terminal-remote-monorepo
description: Auvezy Terminal Remote — 局域网内通过手机/平板浏览器远程控制 PC 终端：atr <program>，多终端多实例自动出现在浏览器顶栏 tab 切换

scripts.build: pnpm prebuild && pnpm --filter auvezy-terminal-remote-shared build && pnpm --filter auvezy-terminal-remote-frontend build && pnpm --filter auvezy-terminal-remote build && pnpm copy-frontend-dist && pnpm bundle-backend
scripts.dev: pnpm copy-frontend-dist && concurrently --kill-others --handle-input -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "pnpm --filter auvezy-terminal-remote dev" "pnpm --filter auvezy-terminal-remote-frontend dev"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter auvezy-terminal-remote-shared test && pnpm --filter auvezy-terminal-remote test && pnpm --filter auvezy-terminal-remote-frontend test
